summary: This tutorial covers how to use presentation notes in LibreOffice Impress for creating and formatting notes. Notes serve two purposes: providing additional content or references for speakers and offering notes for readers when slides are presented. To add notes, open a sample `.odp` file, select a slide, and click on the notes tab. Here, you can type notes and format them by selecting text, choosing a font type and size, and adding bullet points. Notes can be standardized using a notes master, which is accessed via the main menu's view options. Formatting can be applied to all notes by customizing the notes master slide template. Notes can also include logos and shapes; for example, a triangle can be added using the drawing toolbar, formatted with a specific color, and placed on the slide. Notes automatically adopt the formatting set in the notes master. Additionally, the tutorial explains how to resize the notes placeholder by dragging it to the top of the screen, thus adjusting its size relative to the slide.
